invariants.rationale: Method is likely called with non-null names for map lookups.
A new TextureRegion is constructed and returned; thus, result is not null.
The TextureRegion is constructed from images.get(name), so getTexture() returns that.
The returned object is always a TextureRegion.
images.get(name) may be null if the key does not exist; this expresses that if name is not null, the map could contain it.
